**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Serialize the Windows identity recheck with the snapshot**

When both `t125` waiter threads time out on Windows, this identity recheck can run concurrently with the other thread's `_chup_cay`, despite the new snapshot lock. `launcher._khoa_danh_tinh` creates a fresh `_FILETIME` class and overwrites the shared `ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetProcessTimes.argtypes` on every call, so overlapping calls can raise `ctypes.ArgumentError`. A synchronized probe using the actual identity function and ctypes callbacks reproduced this mismatch. The exception escapes `_giu_hau_due_windows` before `taskkill`, aborting cleanup and potentially leaving descendants running. Protect this recheck with the same lock, without holding it across process waits, and add a two-thread regression covering a recheck overlapping a snapshot.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allocate the complete Windows process-memory structure**

When a Windows shard cannot join a Job Object or querying the job fails, its intended process-only RAM fallback is unusable. `_PMC` allocates seven `SIZE_T` fields, but [Microsoft's `PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS` layout](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/psapi/ns-psapi-process_memory_counters) contains eight; on Win64 the supplied buffer is 64 bytes instead of 72. `GetProcessMemoryInfo` therefore fails, `_ram_dinh_mb` returns `None`, and `_loi_gop_dich` rejects an otherwise successful targeted/full audit. Include the missing `PeakPagefileUsage` slot and add a regression exercising `job=None` with the documented buffer size, retaining the explicit process-only measurement label.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Đúng, sẽ vá ở commit `9983615` (chưa push, đang chạy gate cục bộ). Thêm ô `SIZE_T` thứ 8 cho `PeakPagefileUsage`. Ca mới `r553` chạy đường `job=None` với psapi giả: API giả từ chối bộ đệm thiếu ô, như API thật. Ca đếm số ô `SIZE_T` tính từ `peak_ws`, không so kích thước tuyệt đối, vì `wintypes.DWORD` trên Linux là 8 byte nên so tuyệt đối không phân biệt được 7 với 8 ô. Ca giữ nguyên nhãn `windows PeakWorkingSet CHI tien trinh manh`. Đột biến riêng `ram-pmc-thieu-truong` (lùi về 7 ô) làm ca ĐỎ: 1/1 bị giết.
